extension.title: 4. Browser Extension
extension.description: The WoT browser extension provides Web of Trust functionality for Nostr applications. By installing and using the extension, you agree to the following terms:

functionality.title: Functionality
functionality.description: The extension calculates trust scores based on your social graph and the Nostr protocol. Trust scores are subjective measures based on social connections and should not be considered absolute indicators of trustworthiness.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: The extension may receive automatic updates through your browser's extension store. These updates may include bug fixes, security patches, and new features.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Sites
thirdParty.description: The extension interacts with Nostr client websites. We are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or functionality of third-party Nostr clients.

oracle.title: 5. Oracle API
oracle.description: The WoT Oracle is an optional backend service that provides trust calculations. Use of the Oracle API is subject to the following terms:

availability.title: Service Availability
availability.description: The Oracle API is provided on an "as available" basis. We do not guarantee uptime or availability. You may self-host your own Oracle instance using our open-source code.

rateLimit.title: Rate Limiting
rateLimit.description: API requests may be subject to rate limiting to ensure fair usage and protect service stability. Excessive usage may result in temporary or permanent access restrictions.

accuracy.title: Data Accuracy
accuracy.description: Trust calculations are based on publicly available Nostr data. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of the data or calculations.

app.title: 6. Nostr WoT App (iOS)
app.description: These terms also apply to the Nostr WoT app for iOS, published by DANDELION LABS JOINT STOCK COMPANY. The points below add to them for the app and its wallets.

selfCustody.title: Your keys are your responsibility
selfCustody.description: Your keys and seed phrase exist only on your device. We cannot see them, reset your password or PIN, or recover your keys. If you lose your phone and your seed phrase, or someone else gets hold of them, we cannot get your identity or funds back for you. Write down your seed phrase and keep it safe.

signing.title: What you sign
signing.description: You decide which apps may ask for signatures and what the app approves on its own. A signature made by the app counts as your own: check each request before you approve it, and set automatic approvals and payment limits with care.

hostedWallet.title: Hosted Lightning wallet (held by us)
hostedWallet.description: The hosted wallet at zaps.nostr-wot.com is optional and custodial: we hold its balance, so you rely on us and on the service being available. It is not a bank account, it pays no interest and it is not covered by deposit insurance. Keep only small amounts in it. We may set or change limits, for example on app connections and payment amounts, and we may suspend or close the service. If we close it, we will give notice and, where we can, a way to withdraw remaining balances. You can delete the wallet from the app; move your balance out first.

selfCustodialWallet.title: Self-custodial wallet (Breez SDK, Spark)
selfCustodialWallet.description: The self-custodial wallet keeps its keys on your phone, derived from your seed phrase. It runs on the Spark network through the Breez SDK, which are operated by third parties whose terms apply to their services. We do not hold these funds and cannot reverse, recover or block payments made with it.

externalWallets.title: Your own wallet (Nostr Wallet Connect)
externalWallets.description: If you connect your own wallet with Nostr Wallet Connect, that wallet's provider is responsible for it and its terms apply. We are not responsible for wallets, relays or services we do not operate.

noAdvice.title: No financial advice
noAdvice.description: Nothing in the app or on this site is financial, investment, tax or legal advice. Bitcoin and Lightning payments are generally irreversible, and the value of bitcoin can change quickly.

availability.title: Availability by region
availability.description: The app, and some of its features such as the hosted wallet, may not be available in every country, and we may limit or withdraw them where the law requires. You are responsible for using the app in line with the laws that apply to you.

fees.title: Fees
fees.description: The app is free to download. Lightning payments can carry routing or network fees, which are part of the payment.

openSource.title: Open-source components
openSource.description: The app is built with open-source software, including React Native, the Breez SDK, Arti (Tor) and libraries from the Nostr community. Each component is covered by its own license.

appStore.title: App Store
appStore.description: If you downloaded the app from the App Store, Apple's standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement also applies. Apple is not responsible for the app or for supporting it.

liability.title: Losses
liability.description: To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses caused by lost or stolen keys or seed phrases, signatures or payments you approved, wrong addresses or amounts, failures of relays, wallets or networks we do not operate, or changes in the value of bitcoin. Sections 7 and 8 also apply to the app.
